model_config.decoder: local region projection and spatial-query cross-attention
model_config.bottleneck: per-time local spatial attention; no temporal mixing or input token-channel flattening
model_config.quantity_decoder: main full-latent decoder plus patch residual from 32 peak latent features; no raw input bypass
model_config.peak_placement: encoder-only metadata merged after each spatial stride; all 2048 levels per side
model_config.peak_selection: native local maxima q>=left and q>right; strongest K per merged cell; no price NMS
model_config.temporal_alignment: nearest past feature cell by price; zero outside observed range; no future or cross-side matches
model_config.temporal_geometry: stride anchors 2*j+1; final 16*j+15; raw descriptors at anchor only
model_config.latent_layout: 8 local regions x (4 background + 4 peak features); 32+32 learned features per time
model_config.limitations: nearest cell alignment is not individual order tracking; selected input peaks are not guaranteed reconstructed peaks
